title: Profile system and tuning integration — 12 profiles, tuning-dependent defaults
description:
Implement the profile catalog and tuning integration that supply detector/timing defaults without hidden processing (CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §23, §25).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §23 Profiles (all 12 named profiles and intent)
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §25 Tuning Integration (factory tunings and which defaults tuning may adjust)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for profile index / tuning index parameter IDs
- Source/StateManager.h for how profile/tuning are expected to persist in state
- Any existing detector/gate default structures referenced by prior phases

Implement Source/Profiles.h and Source/Profiles.cpp:
- Enumerate exactly these 12 profiles with stable indices/names:
  1) Tight Rhythm — palm-muted, high gain, rapid stops, deep floor, strong transient guard
  2) Low-Tuned Rhythm — 7/8-string / baritone / Drop A+, slower LF envelopes, false-trigger prevention
  3) Fast Alternate Picking — high onset density, fast reopen, cadence-aware
  4) Lead Sustain — bends/vibrato/legato/harmonics, soft floor
  5) Rhythm+Lead Hybrid — full live/recorded performances
  6) Controlled Feedback Lead — held feedback, harmonic verification, safety timeout
  7) Pre-Amp DI — before distortion
  8) Post-Amp Hiss — after amp/cabinet
  9) DI-Keyed Reamp — external sidechain, alignment, lookahead
  10) Stereo Rhythm Bus — linked stereo, hiss suppression, preserved image
  11) Active Bass — active electronics, hum rejection, moderate sustain
  12) Distorted Bass — clean DI key, multiband, preserved LF body
- API: list profiles, lookup by index/id, applyProfileDefaults(APVTS or parameter map) that sets documented default parameters only
- Profiles change defaults and detector behavior weights; do not hide unexposed processing paths

Implement Source/TuningProfiles.h and Source/TuningProfiles.cpp:
- Factory tunings: E/Eb/D/C#/C/B Standard, Drop D/C#/C/B/A, 7-string standard + Drop A, 8-string standard + Drop E, 4/5/6-string bass, custom
- applyTuningAdjustments() may adjust only: key HPF default, low-band crossover default, detector weighting, expected pitch range, sustain analysis bounds, hum-vs-fundamental discrimination
- Must not hard-code the gate to specific note names/MIDI pitches as open/close rules
- Compose cleanly with profile defaults (tuning overlays profile, order documented in header comments)

Do not touch Processor/Editor/CMakeLists or preset JSON in this task.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Profiles module enumerates all 12 named profiles from CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §23 with stable indices
Profiles expose apply/list/lookup APIs that set parameter defaults without hidden processing paths
TuningProfiles covers factory tunings from §25 and adjusts only key HPF, low-band crossover, detector weighting, pitch range, sustain bounds, and hum-vs-fundamental discrimination
Tuning code does not hard-code open/close gate decisions to specific note names
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: hard-code gate open/close to specific musical notes

allowed: use enum class + static tables for profile and tuning defaults
store defaults as parameter-id/value pairs applied via APVTS unlock/set
document apply order: profile then tuning overlay
forbidden: replace APVTS with a parallel parameter system
